violations.why: The compute ISR (priority 6) can preempt main between the two reads in JudgeCondi. Condition3 is 1, so the ISR writes var1 and the two reads can see different values.
The compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR after it writes array[TRIGGER]. It overwrites that element with 999, so the RR ISR's later read at 390 sees the wrong value.
The higher-priority compute ISR can overwrite RT_h after the RR ISR writes it at 409. The RR ISR then reads the clobbered value at 460.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write at 409 and its read at 466.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 after the RR ISR writes it at 411. The RR ISR then reads the clobbered value at 418.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the RR ISR's write at 411 and its read at 451.
